headlines.title: College kids attend ‘Wellness Darties’ as Gen-Z looks for more sober events
headlines.description: More health conscious college kids are celebrating some weekends at "wellness darties." Instead of binge day-drinking, these events have things like pilates, cold plunges or saunas. It's a move for a generation that is less alcohol obsessed. NBC News' Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Naomi Watts Talks National Hot Flash Day, ‘Spider-Man' and More
headlines.description: Naomi Watts sits down with TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to talk about creating National Hot Flash Day and her menopause wellness brand, Stripes Beauty. “With more visibility and normalization we can solve problems.” She opens up about the "inherited shame” of menopause, receiving a career achievement award at the San Sebastián International Film Festival, and her roles in “Spider-Man: Brand New Day” and “All’s Fair.”

headlines.title: Jenna & Sheinelle to Host Girls Getaway: Here’s How to Join Them
headlines.description: TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones are hosting their first event together: Jenna & Sheinelle’s Girls Getaway! Join Jenna and Sheinelle at Cedar Lakes Estate on Oct. 21st and 22nd for wellness activities, sound baths, swag bags, and more!

headlines.title: How to Reset Your Routine, Including Your Sleep, for Fall
headlines.description: With school is back in session and fall right around the corner, NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar stops by TODAY to share tips for getting back into healthy routines. She shares advice for adjusting sleep schedules, resetting movement, lowering screen time, and more.

headlines.title: Apple just launched a folding iPhone — here’s what you need to know
headlines.description: Apple just unveiled its first folding iPhone alongside five other major product launches. Here’s everything you need to know about what’s new.

headlines.title: How to treat and prevent ingrown hair without popping, picking or plucking
headlines.description: How to get rid of ingrown hairs with products from Topicals, Fur, Mario Badescu and more. Here's why dermatologists say you shouldn't pop razor bumps.

headlines.title: Does your dog really need its own bed?
headlines.description: Experts weigh in on the best dog beds to keep your pet well rested. Shop Casper, Big Barker, L.L.Bean, Orvis and more based on comfort, size and quality.

headlines.title: This popular Lenovo monitor is more than $130 off
headlines.description: The Lenovo L32p-30 31.5-inch 4K monitor is 29% off during Lenovo’s Labor Day sale. Shop the deal before the sale ends Sept. 13.

headlines.title: Baby girl is one of two deaths in Pennsylvania measles outbreak, coroner said
headlines.description: A 6-week-old baby girl is one of two people with measles who died in Pennsylvania, the Lancaster County coroner said Friday, as the nation’s measles tally hit a new 35-year record of 3,134 cases.

headlines.title: Texas AG Paxton investigates military healthcare contractor over denied claims
headlines.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has opened an investigation into a major military healthcare contractor over wrongfully denied medical claims.

headlines.title: Pig kidney works for a record 271 days inside the body of American patient
headlines.description: A New Hampshire man, at death’s door 1 ½ years ago, said Friday he could now have “decades” left after surviving a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney — in a procedure that could offer new hope to countless other patients.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.
